title: Combine! Power Squared Equals Speed Squared

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, briefly. To feel the wind.
I am going to explore the realm of top
speed.

"Top speed"—
that phrase brings back memories of the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"To be the fastest means absolute top speed.
Ergo, no one can catch up.
Waiting here was a sound tactical
decision."

Ever since then,
I've wondered about the world through her
eyes.
What kind of view is it that only she gets
to see...?
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, let me come wit...

text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O and I arrived at an obstacle
course in the mountains.
She said we could experience top speed here,
but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Observe this incline.
Lay a piece of cardboard here—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And slide all the way down in one fell
swoop.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeeee-haaaawww!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...And, well, that is how it goes.
choice_data_list: That looks like so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My first encounter with this top speed is
something I shall never forget.
It was one day back in my childhood—

text_block_list.name: Young Light O
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek~! Riding with you makes us go whoooosh,
Daddy!
Again! Let's do it again!

text_block_list.name: Light O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You really love going fast,
don't you?
I'll ride with you as many times as you like
today... Oof.

text_block_list.name: Young Light O
text_block_list.text: Daddy, there's a hole in your pants.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since that day, Father grew hesitant
to participate in cardboard sledding.
choice_data_list: You didn't have to share your dad'...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I refuse to give up.
I will attain that day's top-speed sensation
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, see you shortly.
I shall go seek out a slope with an optimal
angle.

Calstone Light O begins walking off on her
own.
—Right then, inspiration strikes me!

The answer was hidden in what she just told
me...!
A way to witness that top-speed scenery—
together with her!
choice_data_list: Light O, let's slide down together!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Pardon???

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Slide down as a pair,
just like with my father.
And perhaps we will go even more "whoosh."

If we slide down together,
I won't fall behind.
We should be able to witness that top-speed
scenery side by side.

I sit down on Calstone Light O's cardboard
sled.
I check my balance to ensure I won't fall off.
Preparations are complete—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It has been a long time since I felt this.
Trainer, do not get thrown off.
choice_data_list: Right! I won't let go no matter what!
Right! I won't let go no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then—launching!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, WHOA!
Fast! Overwhelmingly fast!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
More,
accelerate more!
I care not if the wind blows my hair off!!
Nay, let it blow away!! WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!

Calstone Light O is thoroughly exhilarated
by the blurring scenery and wind pressure.
I instinctively want to shut my eyes against
the unfamiliar speed,
but desperately force them open.

Suddenly,
I spot a raised mound of dirt right ahead.
At this rate,
we're going to crash right into it...!
choice_data_list: Light O! Look out ahead! Ahead!

text_block_list.text: *(WHOOSH!)*

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—!?!?!?
We're, we're, we're FLYINGGGGG!?!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So cold! So painful! So fast!!
This is... top speed...!

After that,
Calstone Light O's voice abruptly goes
quiet.

What on earth happened?
Pushing through the terror,
I force my eyes open.

—We were in the middle of the sky.
The cardboard sled had launched high into
the air.
So high that we could see both ends of a
rainbow...!
choice_data_list: Light O, the sky is beautiful!
Light O, the sky is beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The sky...? It is true... The sky is...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—ngh...!!
Haha, AHAHAHAHAHA! Incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We! We have harnessed!!
Top speed right here and nooooowwwwww!!!!
*(THUUUUUUD!!)*

We landed spectacularly on our backsides.
Silently thanking the soft, thick grass,
I turn to look at Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know! A speed like this!
A view like that!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I screamed so much a bug flew into my
mouth!!!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know,
I truly didn't—
that something like this could happen...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am glad...
that we could slide down together!

A surge of warmth fills my chest.
The fact that we shared the view at top
speed together
makes me overwhelmingly happy...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
let us go! Back to the realm of top speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That view was truly magnificent! Thus,
onward we must go!
RAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*...!
We slid down... quite a lot...!

How many times did we slide down after
that?
Having savored our airborne journey to the
fullest,
we both worked up a good sweat...!
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head back soon...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, reluctant as I am...
Let us come back to slide again.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for keeping me company.
And one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Your pants are torn in the back.
